## Notes

Maxis, Windows release 2014-09-02, macOS 2015, PS4 and Xbox One 2017, free to play 2022-10-18; emotions, three traits plus aspiration trait, multitasking, Gallery, room-based build mode, life stages, CurseForge partnership.
